problem: Consider a plane lamina of mass $1\,\text{kg}.$ If the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis perpendicular to the lamina passing through its center of mass is $0.8\,\text{kg}\cdot {\text{m}}^{2},$ what is the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis parallel to the first passing through a point on the lamina at a distance of $1.5\,\text{m}$ from its center of mass?

Question 5
?

Consider a plane lamina of mass 1kg. If the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis perpendicular to the lamina passing through its center of mass is 0.8kg⋅m2, what is the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis parallel to the first passing through a point on the lamina at a distance of 1.5m from its center of mass?

a
2.55kg⋅m2
b
3.05kg⋅m2
c
2.25kg⋅m2
d
3.24kg⋅m2
e
1.52kg⋅m2
